extracted.name: Glowing Skin Smoothie
extracted.description: This glowing skin smoothie is not only energy boosting and delicious, it contains ingredients known to keep skin healthy.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup plain coconut water (or more as needed)
optional: 1 Tablespoon ground flax or flaxseed oil
instruction_lines: Make sure you have a strong, powerful blender. I like this Ninja or this Vitamix.

Add all of the ingredients to the blender in the order listed. Blend on high for at least 3 minutes or until smooth. Add more coconut water if needed to thin out. Scrape down the sides of the blender as needed.
